note: IPP head: with `txco dev --ipp` the tenant's `_ipp` stack makes it a printer at ipps://ipp.localhost:8443/p/<printer> once a printer is registered (txco://ipp/printer). The probe cannot speak IPP (HTTP checks only), so it covers what rides the web head: the provision route registers a printer and answers a one-time password, a second provision issues none, the listing route answers, and /p/<printer> on the ORDINARY hostname is the stack's own path — printers exist only on `ipp.<host>`. Printing itself is exercised by the Go tests (chassis/server/personality/ipp) and by hand with ipptool — see the README. Binds localhost → ipp-demo; `ipp.localhost` then resolves to this tenant through that binding.

checks.name: provision: a user, a printer and a one-time password
provision without a printer label is a 400
a label no URL reaches is refused by the op
/p/<printer> on an ordinary hostname is the stack's path, not a printer
